title: Circuit Definitions
description: Definitions of DSP circuits, their interfaces, and implementations.

version.title: Circuit Definitions Version
version.description: The version of this collection of circuit definitions.

name.title: Circuit Name
name.description: The name of the circuit, which must be unique among all circuits and algorithms in use by the system.

is_opaque.title: Is Opaque Circuit
is_opaque.description: Indicates whether this circuit is opaque (i.e., its internal implementation is hidden).

properties.title: Property Definitions
properties.description: An array of definitions for the properties provided by this circuit.

terminals.title: Terminal Definitions
terminals.description: An array of definitions for the terminals provided by this circuit.

parameters.title: Parameter Definitions
parameters.description: An array of definitions for the parameters provided by this circuit.

telemetry.title: Telemetry Definitions
telemetry.description: An array of definitions for the telemetry provided by this circuit.

implementation.title: Circuit Implementation
implementation.description: The implementation details for this circuit.

implementation.title: Circuit Implementation
implementation.description: The implementation details for a circuit.

blocks.title: Block Specifications
blocks.description: An array of specifications for the blocks running within this circuit's implementation.

block_connections.title: Block Connection Specifications
block_connections.description: An array of specifications for signal connections between blocks in this circuit's implementation.

parameter_map.title: Parameter Map Specifications
parameter_map.description: An array of specifications mapping circuit parameters to block parameters.

telemetry_map.title: Telemetry Map Specifications
telemetry_map.description: An array of specifications mapping block telemetry to circuit telemetry.

parameter_settings.title: Parameter Setting Specifications
parameter_settings.description: An array of specifications for parameter settings for the blocks in this circuit.

parameter_map.title: Parameter Map Specification
parameter_map.description: A specification mapping a circuit parameter to a block parameter.

circuit_parameter.title: Circuit Parameter Name
circuit_parameter.description: The name of the circuit parameter being mapped.

block_name.title: Block Name
block_name.description: The name of the block containing the parameter being mapped.

block_parameter.title: Block Parameter Name
block_parameter.description: The name of the block parameter being mapped.

telemetry_map.title: Telemetry Map Specification
telemetry_map.description: A specification mapping block telemetry to circuit telemetry.

circuit_telemetry.title: Circuit Telemetry Name
circuit_telemetry.description: The name of the circuit telemetry being mapped.

block_name.title: Block Name
block_name.description: The name of the block containing the telemetry being mapped.

block_telemetry.title: Block Telemetry Name
block_telemetry.description: The name of the block telemetry being mapped.
